about: Where real-money actions are restricted on this site. The free $1 (score, not cash) works everywhere. One file, read by proxy.ts (the geofence), the money screens and /terms. Change it here only.

policy.blocked: No real-money action at all: no deposit, bet, sale, collection or withdrawal through this site.
policy.close_only: Existing money can leave (sell, collect, withdraw) but no new money goes in (no deposit, no new bet).

sources.name: Polymarket, Geographic Restrictions (geoblock) documentation
sources.used_for: The blocked list (OFAC-sanctioned countries and regions) and the close-only list (Polymarket's countries restricted on both its frontend and its API, and its four Canadian provinces), taken as published.

sources.name: Kalshi Help Center, Can I trade on Kalshi from outside the United States?
sources.used_for: Reference only: Kalshi publishes its restricted jurisdictions in its Member Agreement, which changes over time. Nothing was added from secondary lists.

note: This list mirrors a large operator's published practice; it is not legal advice and makes no claim about the law of any place. The founder must have it reviewed by counsel before limits are raised.

limits.about: The micro-stakes research preview's per-action caps, enforced by this site's screens (the contract itself has no per-person cap).
